title: Terokkar Forest
body: Terokkar Forest spreads across the heart of Outland, a wood of olemba trees thought to take its name from Terokk, the mightiest king the arakkoa remember, whose bird-folk still keep their veils in its groves while his city of Skettis waits in the mountains. The draenei once held this land. Two years ago a Shadow Council summoning tore open their great necropolis of Auchindoun in the south, and the blast scoured the forest around it into the Bone Wastes. Shattrath City rises in the northwest under the Sha'tar.

title: Cenarion Thicket
body: In the forest's north, the Cenarion Thicket was a quiet outpost of the Cenarion Expedition around a tall tower among the trees. Something struck it in a blinding white light, and nearly every druid there died at once. Earthbinder Tavgren, away surveying the Bone Wastes, came back to find only one other survivor, a warden who still wanders the tower in shifting shapes, babbling of light and silence, and the thicket's moths turned vicious.

parts.body: The moths are soaked in pure mana, the residue of the field of energy that struck the thicket; it did not kill them, it maddened them.
sources: quest 9957, 9960, 9961 reward text (druids slain, two survivors, one insane)

parts.body: It was a blood elf bomb of pure mana, a weapon able to take out whole towns, tested on a place of peace. Why, only the broken warden's mind may one day tell.

title: Firewing Point
body: Firewing Point is a blood elf citadel in the northeast of the forest, its spire rising over a walled courtyard where some great work is under way. Its masters serve Kael'thas, and through him Illidan. A Cenarion envoy who came here on a diplomatic mission found herself in a cage, and on the river's banks below, the Alliance and the Horde keep small forward posts watching the spire.

parts.body: The courtyard holds a mana bomb, the second the blood elves have built, and its final code lies with the overseer atop the highest spire.

title: Stonebreaker Hold
body: Stonebreaker Hold is the Horde's town in the middle of the forest, an orc hold of watchtowers commanded by Rokag, who has little patience for anything but defense and supply. Its people are a mixed lot, and for the orc Malukaz, who came by way of Nagrand, the hold is something more: a return to a forest his people once called home, where the old ways are not all lost.

parts.body: Generations ago the wolf spirit had a place among the orc clans of this forest. When they left, it grew lonely and left too. Called with incense from the days of the clans, it answered.

title: Allerian Stronghold
body: The Allerian Stronghold is the Alliance's foothold in eastern Terokkar, named for Alleria Windrunner, and many of its defenders are high elves who stayed in Outland. Captain Auric Sunchaser commands, meeting each new crisis with weary questions about what else could possibly go wrong. Arakkoa raid its roads, fel orcs dig in at the ruins to the east, and to the south lie the Bone Wastes.

parts.body: One of its rangers is an exile who learned her people's fate when the portal opened. Seeing the Farstriders throw in with Kael'thas ended the homecoming she had dreamed of.

title: The Bone Wastes
body: The Bone Wastes are a scar of dust and bleached bone at the heart of the forest, left where the blast from Auchindoun blew the land bare. The dead do not rest here: lost spirits and broken skeletons, draenei corrupted by the explosion, wander in blind torment, ethereals and Shadow Council cabalists pick over the tombs, and a refugee caravan out of the Lower City waits stalled at the northern edge after a night attack.

parts.body: Part of the Shadow Council is fleeing Auchindoun, hiding powerful artifacts in the Shadow Tomb, among them the sacred relics of three draenei patriarchs.

title: Auchindoun
body: Auchindoun was the great necropolis of the draenei, born from a first tomb where Prophet Velen laid the remains of a fallen naaru, and its Auchenai death priests tended its dead for some five hundred years. Then a Shadow Council summoning tore it open. Its wings now hold rival powers: plundering ethereals, maddened Auchenai turned to necromancy, Sethekk arakkoa, and a Shadow Council struggling to contain what it called.

parts.body: The Auchenai feed souls snatched from the battlefield to a coffin dragged out of the crypts, which the Sha'tar believe holds the first exarch, whom they mean to raise.

title: Skettis
body: High in the Skethyl Mountains lies Skettis, the hidden city of the arakkoa around the waters of Blackwind Lake, and from it Terokk's power reaches every veil in the forest. Monstrous kaliri, bred as war birds, nest atop its dwellings. On Terokk's Rest at its heart, the talonpriests believe, their ancient king will one day return. Just outside, the Sha'tari Skyguard, Shattrath's air wing, flies dozens of sorties a day from Blackwind Landing.

parts.body: An almanac taken from a slain talonpriest presages Terokk's return as the most terrible king in arakkoa history, and the redeemed fear the only chance is to call him before he regains his strength.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Skettis (hidden capital of the arakkoa in Blackwind Valley; Terokk's Rest the summoning site)

parts.body: Under Terokk the lowest caste were sacrificed to the dark powers his talonpriests worshipped, a captive arakkoa says, and he would see their hopes undone.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Skettis (hidden capital of the arakkoa in Blackwind Valley; Terokk's Rest the summoning site)

parts.body: Called to Terokk's Rest before the stars aligned, Terokk raged that his powers failed him, boasted that he was immortal, and fell under the Skyguard's bombs.
